scale.1: Easy — urban/community ponds, full facilities, roadside access, guarantee catching fish
scale.2: Fair — road-accessible lakes with basic amenities, fair amount of time to catch fish
scale.3: Moderate — gravel roads, remote drives, mine pits, limited facilities, 50/50 of catching fish
scale.4: Hard — hike or bike access, backcountry trails, able to catch fish with the right techniques and accuracy
scale.5: Difficult — helicopter/fly-in, very remote wilderness, need speciial techniques to catch fish

difficulty.methodology: Ratings derived from My Wild Alberta stocking map site amenities and descriptions (access, remoteness, facilities), with name/type heuristics and manual overrides where MWA has no listing.
